label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is alert-TP. The sink expression response.sendRedirect(param) at line 21 receives the value of param, which is populated from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest") at line 13. Although the code includes a guard clause checking if the remote address starts with "10." (lines 16-18), this condition acts as a gatekeeper rather than a sanitization mechanism. Once the condition is met, the user-supplied param is passed directly to the redirect sink without modification. An attacker accessing the service from an IP within the 10.x.x.x range can inject arbitrary URLs, resulting in an open redirect vulnerability. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User input from getParameter flows directly to sendRedirect sink without sanitization
